name: agent-harness-design
description: Design and review provider-neutral agent harnesses with calibrated constraints, explicit authority boundaries, and evidence-driven evaluation.

interface.shortDescription: Calibrate agent architecture without freezing model agency.
interface.longDescription: Adds a provider-neutral Skill for designing, auditing, debugging, and evaluating agent harnesses. It distinguishes hard trust boundaries from defaults and task-dependent patterns so controls stay proportional to evidence, authority, and risk.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $agent-harness-design to design or review this agent system. Separate hard invariants from defaults and conditional patterns, preserve model agency inside the authorized boundary, and define observable evaluation evidence.
